title.en: Konyaku haki sareta muhyoujou reijou ga shiawase ni naru made ~Kinmusaki no tennen tarashi kishidan-chou-sama ga torottoro ni amayakashite dekiai shite kuru no desu ga!?~
Konyaku Haki Shita Aite ga Mainichi Shazai ni Kimasu ga, Fukuen Nante Zettai ni Ariemasen!
Watashi no Konyakusha-sama no Dokuzetsu ga Sugiru ~Minna ni Shio Taiou no Hazu ga Watashi wa Dekiai Sareteimasu~
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Enzai Reijou wa Shinjitai - Ginpatsu ga Fukitsu to Iwarete Konyaku Hakisareta Shishaku Reijou wa Ansatsu Kizoku ni Dekiaisarete Daini no Jinsei wo Tannou suru you desu
Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?
Konyaku Haki Shita wo Baka na Ouji wa Hottoite, Akuyaku Reijou wa Seirei no Mori de Shiawase ni Narimasu.
Seiryaku Kekkon no Otto ni "Aisanakute Kekkou desu" to Sengen Shitara Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Ochikobore Reijou wa, Koushaku Kakka kara no Dekiai ni Kizukanai ~Konyakusha ni Shimeisareta no wa Saishoku Kenbi no Ane de wa Naku, Watashi deshita~
Zetsumetsukigushu Hanayome Shiitagerareta Hime desu ga Ouji-sama no Noroi wo Hodoite Shiawase ni narimasu
Doumo, Akuyaku ni Sareta Reijou desukeredo
Senjou no Seijo ~Imouto no Kawari ni Koushaku Kishi ni Totsugu Koto ni narimashita ga, Ima wa Shiawase desu~
Kao ga Miwakerarenai Hakushaku Reijou Desu ga, Akunin Koushaku-sama ni Dekiai Sarete Imasu
Binbou Kishi ni Yomeiri Shita Hazu ga!? Yajin Reijou wa Koutaishihi ni Natte mo Ryuu wo Karitai
Migawari Konyaku Shananoni, Gin Ookami Heika ga Doushitemo Hanashite Kuremasen!
